captions.caption: The video begins with a dark and blurry view from inside a vehicle moving through a storm.
A brief, shaky glimpse of a dark sky is seen through the car's window.
The camera pans across a field under a dark, turbulent sky just before a tornado appears.
A large, dark tornado funnel is clearly visible in the distance across a green field.
The massive tornado churns up debris at its base as it moves slowly across the landscape.
The camera focuses on the wide, rotating column of the tornado against the overcast sky.
High winds and dust are visible in the foreground of the field near the tornado.
The tornado appears massive and menacing as it dominates the horizon.
The storm chaser films the tornado from a dirt road, showing the scale of the storm.
The funnel of the tornado is thick and dark, indicating its significant power.
Debris is seen being lifted into the air around the base of the rotating storm.
The sky is a deep shade of gray, highlighting the dark silhouette of the tornado.
The camera shakes slightly as the intense winds of the storm pick up.
The tornado continues its path across the open field, viewed from the safety of the car.
A final clear shot of the tornado's full height is captured before the scene changes.
The camera view cuts to a dark and extremely shaky interior shot of the vehicle.
Flashes of light and movement are visible as the car is buffeted by the storm.
The camera captures a close-up view of the tornado's edge through the car window.
Debris and heavy rain lash against the side of the vehicle as the tornado passes near.
A wooden fence and green grass are visible in the foreground as the tornado looms close.
The rotating wall of the tornado is seen very close to the storm chaser's position.
The camera shakes violently as the vehicle is hit by the intense winds of the tornado.
The screen goes dark and shaky again as the core of the storm passes over.
A man wearing a red shirt is seen frantically moving inside the car.
He climbs from the passenger side toward the driver's seat as the storm rages.
The man's face shows concern as he looks out the window at the passing tornado.
He adjusts his position in the driver's seat, preparing to move the vehicle.
The interior of the car is illuminated by the dim, stormy light from outside.
The man reaches for the steering wheel while still looking back at the storm.
He settles into the driver's seat, appearing focused on navigating away from danger.
The camera focuses on the man's red shirt as he moves around the car's cabin.
He looks out the side window, tracking the tornado's movement through the rain.
The man grabs the gear shifter and prepares to drive the car forward.
The view shifts to the dashboard and windshield as the wipers move at high speed.
Heavy rain and a green-tinted sky are visible through the car's front window.
The camera captures the top of the steering wheel and the dashboard in the dim light.
The windshield wipers continue to clear the heavy rain as the car moves.
Outside, the landscape is a blur of dark green and gray due to the storm.
The camera pans slightly, showing the interior roof and sun visor of the car.
Raindrops are seen streaking across the side window of the vehicle.
The sky remains a dark, menacing shade of green through the windshield.
The car's wipers work frantically to maintain visibility in the downpour.
The interior of the car is dark, with only the light from the storm outside.
The camera focus is on the upper part of the dashboard and the car's frame.
A view out the window shows the intense rain and wind buffeting the area.
The car continues to drive through the hazardous weather conditions.
The windshield wipers are the main movement visible in the frame.
The sky appears slightly lighter in some areas, but is still mostly dark.
The camera captures the side of the car's interior as it jolts on the road.
Rain continues to fall heavily, partially obscuring the view of the horizon.
The camera pans down to show the dashboard and front air vents.
Outside, the storm clouds are thick and turbulent as the car moves away.
The windshield wipers cross the frame repeatedly, clearing water.
The view out the front shows a road stretching into the dark, rainy distance.
The camera pans to the side window, revealing the tornado in the distance.
A large, dark tornado funnel is visible across the fields from the moving car.
The tornado appears as a wide, dark column under the low-hanging clouds.
The car's side mirror is visible in the frame, reflecting the dark sky.
The tornado is still quite large and powerful as it moves away from the road.
The video ends with a final shot of the tornado in the distance through the car window.
